faqLeft.q: What engine does the Range Rover P510e use?
faqLeft.a: The Range Rover P510e uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with a 105kW electric motor as part of the plug-in hybrid system. It's the same engine family that appears across the P440e, P460e, P510e and P550e badges, with different combined power outputs depending on the tier.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover P510e engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover P510e?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine spec — the P510e uses the AJ300P engine code across all current L460-generation cars.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ300P Range Rover P510e engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ300P rebuild, and fully service the engine ancillaries.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover P510e engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover P510e if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover P510e engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover P510e owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
